description: This file defines a React component for a To-Do list page in a Next.js application. It includes functionalities such as loading tasks, filtering, adding, editing, toggling completion status, and deleting tasks. It also handles user authentication state and route navigation.

methods.name: TodosPage
methods.description: Main React component for the Todo page, manages state and handles CRUD operations for todos.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new todo item using API, updates local state.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Toggles completion status of a todo item, updates via API.

methods.name: handleEditSubmit
methods.description: Submits the edited todo data, updates via API, and updates local state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a todo item via API and updates local state.
